claims.value: OpenAI's open-weight model for text generation, supporting reasoning, agentic tasks, and developer use cases.
MoE model with 117B total parameters and 5.1B active parameters, quantized to MXFP4 for single 80GB GPU deployment.
claims.evidence: The models were post-trained with MXFP4 quantization of the MoE weights

claims.value: Supports configurable reasoning effort (low, medium, high) with full access to chain-of-thought reasoning.
claims.evidence: Full chain-of-thought: Gain complete access to the model’s reasoning process

claims.value: Native support for function calling, web browsing, Python code execution, and Structured Outputs.
claims.evidence: Agentic capabilities: Use the models’ native capabilities for function calling

claims.value: Trained on the harmony response format; must be used with this format to work correctly.
claims.evidence: Both models were trained on our harmony response format

claims.value: Fully fine-tunable for specialized use cases.
claims.evidence: Fine-tunable: Fully customize models to your specific use case through parameter fine-tuning.

claims.value: Released under Apache 2.0 license, allowing free commercial deployment and customization.
Officially supported via Hugging Face Transformers.
claims.evidence: You can use gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b with Transformers.

claims.value: Supports three reasoning levels (low, medium, high) adjustable via system prompts.
